B1_trade_update_dlq.description: After 3 retry attempts, failed trade updates are now written to a DLQ file (/tmp/intra_trade_update_dlq.jsonl, configurable via INTRA_DLQ_PATH). Each entry includes timestamp, attempt count, error, and raw payload. Session counter _dlq_count tracks total dead-lettered updates.

B2_websocket_gap_fill_hardening.description: Gap-fill lookback window now computed from actual disconnect duration (gap + 60s buffer, min 5min, max 1hr). Reconnect counter tracks session instability with CRITICAL log at 10+ reconnects. _last_connected_at timestamp tracks connection epochs.

B3_audit_session_resilience.description: Added refresh_session() to update stale DB session. _check_session_health() detects None or inactive sessions. log() raises RuntimeError on stale session (fail-loud). reset() class method clears singleton.
